definition: a building for fire engines and crews
description: At night in heavy snow, an old red-brick fire station with three arched garage doors stands open and brightly lit, showing red fire engines inside. Through a tall lit window upstairs a firefighter slides down a brass pole. A fire engine with flashing red lights drives out of the middle door, crosses the snowy forecourt and turns onto the road. Firefighters in yellow gear stand by the doors, and a bell hangs in the tower above. Tyre tracks cross the snow in front.
